mad-men.synopsis: The series finale follows Don Draper, his family, and his former colleagues as they confront where their lives are headed.

chernobyl.synopsis: In the early hours of April 1986, reactor operators and Pripyat firefighters scramble to make sense of a blast at the Soviet nuclear plant.

chernobyl.title: Please Remain Calm
chernobyl.synopsis: As officials downplay the danger, scientist Valery Legasov is flown to the site while physicist Ulana Khomyuk races to warn Moscow of a looming second threat.

chernobyl.title: Open Wide, O Earth
chernobyl.synopsis: Legasov sets out a cleanup plan with grim human costs, while a firefighter's wife defies warnings to stay near her husband in a Moscow hospital.

chernobyl.title: The Happiness of All Mankind
chernobyl.synopsis: Legasov and Shcherbina look to machines and then soldiers to clear lethal rooftop debris, as Khomyuk runs into state obstruction while investigating the accident's cause.

chernobyl.title: Vichnaya Pamyat
chernobyl.synopsis: At a trial in a contaminated town, Legasov, Shcherbina and Khomyuk weigh what speaking honestly about the disaster could cost them personally.

the-sopranos.title: The Sopranos
the-sopranos.synopsis: New Jersey mob boss Tony Soprano reluctantly begins therapy with Dr. Jennifer Melfi after a series of panic attacks, opening up about family and business.

the-sopranos.title: 46 Long
the-sopranos.synopsis: With the acting boss gravely ill, Tony maneuvers around his uncle Junior, while Christopher hijacks a truck of DVD players and Tony pushes his mother into a retirement home.

the-sopranos.title: Denial, Anger, Acceptance
the-sopranos.synopsis: Junior's associate stokes his suspicion of Tony, while Tony, Paulie and Silvio take on a family problem for a Hasidic motel owner.

the-sopranos.title: Meadowlands
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony faces a hard leadership choice as Jackie Aprile's health declines, A.J. learns more about his father's work, and Tony has Dr. Melfi investigated.

the-sopranos.title: College
the-sopranos.synopsis: While touring Maine colleges with Meadow, Tony spots someone he believes is a former mobster turned informant; back home, Carmela spends an evening with Father Phil.

the-sopranos.title: Pax Soprana
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony arranges for Junior to become the new boss, surprises Dr. Melfi during a session, and struggles with side effects that frustrate the women in his life.

the-sopranos.title: Down Neck
the-sopranos.synopsis: After A.J. gets into trouble at school, Tony worries his own influence is to blame and recalls childhood memories of his father's line of work.

the-sopranos.title: The Legend of Tennessee Moltisanti
the-sopranos.synopsis: News of coming federal indictments sends the crew scrambling to clean house, while a restless Christopher feels overlooked and grows agitated.

the-sopranos.title: Boca
the-sopranos.synopsis: Junior's private life becomes awkward gossip, and controversy erupts when the coach of Meadow's soccer team announces he is leaving the school.

the-sopranos.title: A Hit Is a Hit
the-sopranos.synopsis: Christopher and Adriana try breaking into the music industry, while a rapper presses Hesh about old royalties and Tony golfs with his neighbor's friends.

the-sopranos.title: Nobody Knows Anything
the-sopranos.synopsis: After an FBI raid, Tony is told that Pussy might be cooperating with authorities, and he sends Paulie to find out whether the rumor is true.

the-sopranos.title: Isabella
the-sopranos.synopsis: Deep in depression and a medicated haze, Tony is intrigued by a young Italian dental student staying next door, while danger closes in around him.

the-sopranos.title: I Dream of Jeannie Cusamano
the-sopranos.synopsis: In the season finale, Tony learns troubling information about a possible betrayal and confronts the fallout of his therapy becoming common knowledge.

the-sopranos.title: Guy Walks into a Psychiatrist's Office
the-sopranos.synopsis: Season two opens with Tony settling in as boss, Junior in jail, Dr. Melfi refusing to see him, and his sister Janice arriving in town.

the-sopranos.title: Do Not Resuscitate
the-sopranos.synopsis: When protesters picket a construction site, Tony works both sides to resolve it, while Janice gets drawn into managing Livia's affairs.

the-sopranos.title: Toodle-Fucking-Oo
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony catches Meadow throwing a party at her grandmother's empty house, and newly released Richie Aprile wastes no time looking for action.

the-sopranos.title: Commendatori
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony travels to Naples with Paulie and Christopher to set up a car-theft operation, where Tony negotiates with a powerful family and Paulie seeks his roots.

the-sopranos.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
the-sopranos.synopsis: New recruit Furio makes a forceful first impression in New Jersey, Dr. Melfi discusses her guilt with her therapist, and Christopher tries acting classes.

the-sopranos.title: The Happy Wanderer
the-sopranos.synopsis: A gambling father of Meadow's friend falls deep into debt at Tony's poker game, while a funeral forces Tony to deal with Livia.

the-sopranos.title: D-Girl
the-sopranos.synopsis: As A.J.'s confirmation approaches, his parents worry about his apathy, while Christopher's interest in Hollywood is rekindled by a film-industry connection.

the-sopranos.title: Full Leather Jacket
the-sopranos.synopsis: Richie tries to make peace with Tony after a dispute, while two of Christopher's frustrated associates make a bold move to prove themselves.

the-sopranos.title: From Where to Eternity
the-sopranos.synopsis: Christopher has a frightening near-death experience that unsettles Paulie, Carmela pushes Tony on a vasectomy, and Dr. Melfi confides in her own therapist.

the-sopranos.title: Bust Out
the-sopranos.synopsis: Richie complains to Tony and then to Junior, Tony slowly drains a gambling-addicted store owner's business, and Carmela meets a charming neighbor.

the-sopranos.title: House Arrest
the-sopranos.synopsis: Advised by his lawyer to appear legitimate, Tony spends days at a waste management office, while Junior finds company during his house arrest.

the-sopranos.title: The Knight in White Satin Armor
the-sopranos.synopsis: Engaged couple Richie and Janice have an explosive argument, while Irina takes desperate steps to win Tony back.

the-sopranos.title: Funhouse
the-sopranos.synopsis: In the season finale, Tony suffers food poisoning that sends him into vivid fever dreams, helping him confront a suspicion he has avoided.

the-sopranos.title: Mr. Ruggerio's Neighborhood
the-sopranos.synopsis: The FBI launches an elaborate operation to plant a listening device in the Soprano home, while Tony handles questions from a grieving soldier.

the-sopranos.title: Proshai, Livushka
the-sopranos.synopsis: A death in the family brings Janice back to arrange a funeral, as Tony struggles with conflicting feelings and the gathering takes strange turns.

the-sopranos.title: Fortunate Son
the-sopranos.synopsis: Christopher learns that being a made man brings new pressures, while Janice moves into her mother's house and settles a dispute with the former caretaker.

the-sopranos.title: Employee of the Month
the-sopranos.synopsis: Dr. Melfi's plan to steer Tony toward behavioral therapy is interrupted by a personal crisis, and Ralph Cifaretto takes Jackie Jr. under his wing.

the-sopranos.title: Another Toothpick
the-sopranos.synopsis: A retired hit man comes out of retirement to handle a young hothead, worrying his son Bobby and Uncle Junior.

the-sopranos.title: University
the-sopranos.synopsis: Ralph's troubled relationship with a Bada Bing dancer disrupts nights at the club, while Meadow's college romance is tested by a needy roommate.

the-sopranos.title: Second Opinion
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony pushes Junior to get a second opinion on his cancer care, while Carmela debates seeing a therapist of her own.

the-sopranos.title: He Is Risen
the-sopranos.synopsis: As Thanksgiving approaches, Tony's feud with Ralph escalates despite Johnny Sack's mediation, while Meadow and Jackie Jr. grow closer.

the-sopranos.title: The Telltale Moozadell
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony gives Carmela a birthday present, Christopher hands Adriana a nightclub of her own, and A.J. gets in trouble for vandalizing the school pool.

the-sopranos.title: To Save Us All from Satan's Power
the-sopranos.synopsis: A Christmas season visit with old memories sends Tony back to Melfi, while Bobby reluctantly agrees to take over as Santa at the holiday party.

the-sopranos.title: Pine Barrens
the-sopranos.synopsis: Paulie and Christopher get stranded in the snowy South Jersey woods after a debt collection goes wrong, while Tony juggles his family and his girlfriend.

the-sopranos.title: Amour Fou
the-sopranos.synopsis: Inspired by Ralph's stories, Jackie Jr. plans to rob a card game to make a name for himself, while Tony's affair with Gloria grows turbulent.

the-sopranos.title: Army of One
the-sopranos.synopsis: In the season finale, A.J.'s latest school trouble has his parents considering military school, while Tony makes demands of Ralph regarding Jackie Jr.

the-sopranos.title: For All Debts Public and Private
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony invests in a land deal despite Carmela's money worries, Junior's trial approaches, and Adriana brings a new friend to Sunday dinner.

the-sopranos.title: No-Show
the-sopranos.synopsis: With Paulie in prison, Christopher becomes acting captain and gets off to a rocky start, while Meadow considers taking a year off from college.

the-sopranos.title: Christopher
the-sopranos.synopsis: Silvio and Ralph handle a planned Native American protest of the Columbus Day parade, while Carmela is embarrassed at an Italian pride luncheon.

the-sopranos.title: The Weight
the-sopranos.synopsis: A crude joke about his wife sends Johnny Sack on a vendetta that tests Tony's diplomacy, and Furio hosts a housewarming party.

the-sopranos.title: Pie-O-My
the-sopranos.synopsis: While visiting Ralph's racehorse, Tony develops an unexpected bond with the animal, and Adriana's nightclub becomes a gathering spot for Christopher's crew.

the-sopranos.title: Everybody Hurts
the-sopranos.synopsis: Artie lends money to the brother of his new hostess, Christopher takes on new duties, and Carmela sets Furio up on a date.

the-sopranos.title: Watching Too Much Television
the-sopranos.synopsis: Paulie returns from prison to a celebration and old tensions quickly resurface, while Tony and Ralph pursue a real estate scheme suggested by Carmela's cousin.

the-sopranos.title: Mergers and Acquisitions
the-sopranos.synopsis: Paulie tries to help his mother fit in at her retirement community, Furio visits his ailing father in Italy, and Ralph introduces Tony to his new girlfriend.

the-sopranos.title: Whoever Did This
the-sopranos.synopsis: Junior's legal team tries a new strategy after damaging press coverage, Ralph plays pranks at Paulie's expense, and Tony finds solace at the stables.

the-sopranos.title: The Strong, Silent Type
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony describes himself to Melfi as a sad clown, Carmela drags A.J. along to help Furio decorate, and the crew stages an intervention for a struggling member.

the-sopranos.title: Calling All Cars
the-sopranos.synopsis: After a sitdown with the New York family, Tony reconsiders a business partnership, while Janice grows impatient with Bobby and Melfi probes Tony's dreams.

the-sopranos.title: Eloise
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony continues negotiating with New York over Esplanade profits, Carmela makes plans she can't keep, and Furio accompanies Tony to a casino.

the-sopranos.title: Whitecaps
the-sopranos.synopsis: In the season finale, Tony and Carmela consider buying a beach house, but a voice from Tony's past threatens to unravel their plans.

the-sopranos.title: Two Tonys
the-sopranos.synopsis: A wave of paroled gangsters changes the balance between the New Jersey and New York families, while Tony adjusts to life apart from Carmela.

the-sopranos.title: Rat Pack
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony welcomes his cousin Tony Blundetto home after years in prison, while Carmela launches a film club and Adriana wrestles with guilt.

the-sopranos.title: Where's Johnny?
the-sopranos.synopsis: Johnny Sack bristles at Tony's power-sharing approach, a paroled old-timer crosses Paulie in the landscaping business, and Tony finds a new place to stay.

the-sopranos.title: All Happy Families
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony and Carmela meet to discuss A.J.'s dim college prospects, an old-school associate entertains the crew with stories, and A.J. enjoys a night in Manhattan.

the-sopranos.title: Irregular Around the Margins
the-sopranos.synopsis: While Christopher is away, Tony gives Adriana a ride that ends badly, and the story gets distorted as it spreads through the crew.

the-sopranos.title: Sentimental Education
the-sopranos.synopsis: Carmela spends extra time with A.J.'s guidance counselor as she pushes for his future, while Tony Blundetto finds that going straight is harder than expected.

the-sopranos.title: In Camelot
the-sopranos.synopsis: A conversation with his late father's former mistress reveals unsettling things to Tony, while Christopher struggles with a friend's addiction.

the-sopranos.title: Marco Polo
the-sopranos.synopsis: Family and friends gather at the Soprano house for Carmela's father's 75th birthday, while Tony B. weighs an offer that could change his future.

the-sopranos.title: Unidentified Black Males
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony's relationship with Johnny Sack becomes strained over rumors, Meadow helps her boyfriend find work, and A.J. faces a strict summer at home.

the-sopranos.title: Cold Cuts
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony B. and Christopher reminisce on a country trip, Janice ends up in anger management, and Tony plans another party with Carmela.

the-sopranos.title: The Test Dream
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony checks into the Plaza Hotel for a restful night, but his sleep fills with strange dreams populated by figures from his past.

the-sopranos.title: Long Term Parking
the-sopranos.synopsis: With federal agents pressing her, Adriana weighs her options, while Tony and his cousin have a frank conversation and Carmela gets a real-estate offer.

the-sopranos.title: All Due Respect
the-sopranos.synopsis: In the season finale, Tony's crew braces for pressure from Johnny Sack, Christopher has a startling visitor, and Carmela reflects on her blessings.

the-sopranos.title: Members Only
the-sopranos.synopsis: A former associate tries to leave mob life behind, while Junior's growing confusion and paranoia make him a danger to those around him.

the-sopranos.title: Join the Club
the-sopranos.synopsis: The family copes with a sudden crisis, while Tony experiences a strange parallel existence as a traveling salesman in California.

the-sopranos.title: Mayham
the-sopranos.synopsis: While the crew squabbles over power and money, Tony finds himself suspended in a dreamlike place on the threshold.

the-sopranos.title: The Fleshy Part of the Thigh
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony returns home and to business with a renewed perspective, while Paulie receives startling news about his mother.

the-sopranos.title: Mr. & Mrs. John Sacrimoni Request...
the-sopranos.synopsis: Johnny Sack seeks permission to leave prison for his daughter's wedding, while Tony looks for ways to assert his strength.

the-sopranos.title: Live Free or Die
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony seeks advice to handle a sensitive problem with a top earner, and must decide whether the man deserves another chance.

the-sopranos.title: Luxury Lounge
the-sopranos.synopsis: Christopher travels to Los Angeles to court a Hollywood star for his film project, while Artie's hospitality is abused at his restaurant.

the-sopranos.title: Johnny Cakes
the-sopranos.synopsis: Vito, hiding out in New Hampshire, considers starting a new life, while A.J. struggles with feelings of revenge.

the-sopranos.title: The Ride
the-sopranos.synopsis: Paulie faces public anger after an accident at a church festival, while Christopher tries to settle into life as a husband and father.

the-sopranos.title: Moe n' Joe
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony reflects on how growing up with Janice shaped him, while Vito tries to build a new life in New Hampshire.

the-sopranos.title: Cold Stones
the-sopranos.synopsis: Phil Leotardo looks to settle a score, while Tony grows frustrated with A.J.'s lack of ambition and work ethic.

the-sopranos.title: Kaisha
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tensions between New York and New Jersey keep simmering, Christopher wrestles with addiction, Carmela works on her spec house, and A.J. has a new girlfriend.

the-sopranos.title: Soprano Home Movies
the-sopranos.synopsis: Bobby and Janice host Tony's birthday weekend at their Adirondacks lake house, where old resentments surface over drinks and board games.

the-sopranos.title: Stage 5
the-sopranos.synopsis: Christopher's horror film premieres, revealing how he feels about Tony, while Johnny Sack faces a health crisis and power shifts in New York.

the-sopranos.title: Remember When
the-sopranos.synopsis: When an old crime threatens to resurface, Tony and Paulie head to Florida, where Tony weighs their long friendship.

the-sopranos.title: Chasing It
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony's luck sours as a gambling streak strains his friendship with Hesh, while A.J. makes a significant decision about his future.

the-sopranos.title: Walk Like a Man
the-sopranos.synopsis: The relationship between Christopher and Paulie falters, while A.J. sinks into depression after a breakup.

the-sopranos.title: Kennedy and Heidi
the-sopranos.synopsis: The New Jersey and New York families clash over an asbestos job, while Tony deals with a problematic associate and A.J. questions his friendships.

the-sopranos.title: The Second Coming
the-sopranos.synopsis: Tony tries to mend the rift between New Jersey and New York, A.J.'s struggle with depression continues, and a New York associate crosses a line with Meadow.

the-sopranos.title: The Blue Comet
the-sopranos.synopsis: Suspicion of disloyalty hangs over Tony's crew as Phil Leotardo weighs how to handle his escalating conflict with the Sopranos.

the-sopranos.title: Made in America
the-sopranos.synopsis: In the series finale, Tony seeks a resolution with New York while worrying about a possible informant, and the family gathers amid uncertainty.

mare-of-easttown.title: Miss Lady Hawk Herself
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: In a small Pennsylvania town, detective Mare Sheehan responds to a prowler call while facing local pressure to solve a year-old missing-person case.

mare-of-easttown.title: Fathers
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: Mare investigates a grim crime scene and breaks hard news to a grieving father, while a county detective is assigned to help her.

mare-of-easttown.title: Enter Number Two
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: As Mare and partner Colin Zabel examine new evidence, phone records point to an unexpected suspect, and Mare's family tensions over her grandson escalate.

mare-of-easttown.title: Poor Sisyphus
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: Sidelined from the case, Mare watches as Colin questions a local priest about his past, while an anonymous call gives a worried mother new hope.

mare-of-easttown.title: Illusions
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: In mandated therapy, Mare opens up about her family's history, while her best friend Lori tries to understand her son's troubling behavior at school.

mare-of-easttown.title: Sore Must Be the Storm
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: Recovering in the hospital after a dangerous encounter, Mare gets another shot at the case from her chief and starts revisiting old suspects.

mare-of-easttown.title: Sacrament
mare-of-easttown.synopsis: As her investigation reaches a turning point, Mare and her community grapple with the case and its effects on the people closest to her.

the-queens-gambit.title: Openings
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: After losing her mother, young Beth Harmon is placed in a Kentucky orphanage, where the custodian introduces her to chess.

the-queens-gambit.title: Exchanges
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: Adopted by a suburban couple, teenage Beth navigates an awkward high school life and schemes to enter her first chess tournament.

the-queens-gambit.title: Doubled Pawns
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: Beth and her adoptive mother begin traveling the tournament circuit, attracting press attention as Beth aims for the U.S. Open in Las Vegas.

the-queens-gambit.title: Middle Game
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: A Russian class leads Beth into a new social circle, and a tournament in Mexico City brings her face to face with world champion Borgov.

the-queens-gambit.title: Fork
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: Back home in Kentucky, Beth accepts training help from a former opponent as she prepares for the U.S. Championship.

the-queens-gambit.title: Adjournment
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: After intense preparation in New York, Beth travels to Paris for a rematch with Borgov, but a night out threatens her focus.

the-queens-gambit.title: End Game
the-queens-gambit.synopsis: A visit from an old friend pushes Beth to confront her past as she heads to Moscow for the most important tournament of her career.

the-wire.title: The Target
the-wire.synopsis: After embarrassing his bosses in court, detective Jimmy McNulty is shunted onto a mismatched unit tasked with building a case against West Baltimore drug boss Avon Barksdale.

the-wire.title: The Detail
the-wire.synopsis: A key courtroom witness turns up dead, raising the stakes for McNulty, while Kima Greggs learns the Barksdale hierarchy and a reckless night raid at the towers goes badly.

the-wire.title: The Buys
the-wire.synopsis: Herc, Carver and Prez stir up a neighborhood uproar with a heavy-handed early sweep, while D'Angelo uses a chessboard to explain the drug trade to his young crew.

the-wire.title: Old Cases
the-wire.synopsis: The detail leans on an arrested dealer to cooperate, Avon puts a price on stick-up man Omar, and McNulty brings informant Bubbles along on an unusual outing.

the-wire.title: The Pager
the-wire.synopsis: Cloned pagers finally give the detail a window into the Barksdale crew, but the numbers come in a code that nobody on the team can read at first.

the-wire.title: The Wire
the-wire.synopsis: Pressured to close three murders quickly, the brass want arrests now, so McNulty and Greggs fight to protect the slow, patient wiretap investigation they have built.

the-wire.title: One Arrest
the-wire.synopsis: A seizure based on intercepted calls puts Avon and Stringer on guard, while Bunk and McNulty go hunting for another witness to the Gant murder.

the-wire.title: Lessons
the-wire.synopsis: McNulty gets a lead on Stringer Bell's car from an unexpected place, Greggs and Carver stop a political aide carrying cash, and Omar's war with Barksdale escalates.

the-wire.title: Game Day
the-wire.synopsis: Avon flexes his wealth in a heated rivalry with an east side crew, while Herc and Carver grab a bag of money and Omar makes his presence felt again.

the-wire.title: The Cost
the-wire.synopsis: The detail must figure out how to protect young witness Wallace until trial, Prez reveals a knack for tracing money, and McNulty's family life grows more strained.

the-wire.title: The Hunt
the-wire.synopsis: Commanders demand flashy arrests for the cameras, Barksdale's ranks thin after recent violence, Bubbles tries to stay clean, and Freamon suspects someone is leaking information.

the-wire.title: Cleaning Up
the-wire.synopsis: With the pay phones gone dark, the detail tries to get inside Avon's office, D'Angelo travels to New York on an errand, and Daniels battles the department's politics.

the-wire.title: Sentencing
the-wire.synopsis: As pressure mounts on the Barksdale organization, Daniels and McNulty look beyond their chain of command to push the case forward in the season one finale.

the-wire.title: Ebb Tide
the-wire.synopsis: Exiled to the marine unit, McNulty finds something disturbing in the harbor, while the Barksdale crew seeks new suppliers and Stringer Bell meets with wary partners in New York.

the-wire.title: Collateral Damage
the-wire.synopsis: A petty feud between police major Valchek and dockworkers' union leader Frank Sobotka escalates, while Avon keeps running his business from behind prison walls.

the-wire.title: Hot Shots
the-wire.synopsis: Bunk and Freamon follow a case up the coast to Philadelphia, Daniels chafes at his dead-end posting, and Stringer arranges a setup on Avon's behalf inside the prison.

the-wire.title: Hard Cases
the-wire.synopsis: Frank Sobotka scolds his nephew Nick over a botched side deal, while McNulty obsesses over an unidentified body and Bunk is sent looking for Omar to testify.

the-wire.title: Undertow
the-wire.synopsis: Ziggy loses his beloved car to local dealers, homicide hands out grand jury summonses on the docks, and port officer Beadie Russell digs into how cargo vanishes.

the-wire.title: All Prologue
the-wire.synopsis: McNulty tries to let go of police work and focus on his marriage, while the detectives trace a computer pattern linked to the port and Sobotka lobbies politicians.

the-wire.title: Backwash
the-wire.synopsis: The detail secretly tracks shipping containers through a cloned port computer, and Greggs and Prez stumble onto a ring of trafficked women operating in the city.

the-wire.title: Duck and Cover
the-wire.synopsis: McNulty drifts back into drinking, Ziggy endures another humiliation on the docks, and the long-sought wiretap finally comes online as Sobotka meets his shadowy business partners.

the-wire.title: Stray Rounds
the-wire.synopsis: Bodie's sales push sparks fresh trouble on the corners, Ziggy hatches a risky scheme, and McNulty waits nervously during an undercover assignment inside a brothel.

the-wire.title: Storm Warnings
the-wire.synopsis: Satellite tracking gives the detail an edge, Bodie bristles at rivals working his turf, Stringer considers an unusual fix, and Ziggy's partnership with a fence turns tense.

the-wire.title: Bad Dreams
the-wire.synopsis: Racing against time, the detail makes a bold play as Sobotka faces mounting bad news, Nick tries to mend fences with the Greeks, and Omar acts on his suspicions.

the-wire.title: Port in a Storm
the-wire.synopsis: In the second season finale, the detail regroups after a setback while Bunk and Russell return to Philadelphia and Stringer faces pressure from both Avon and Brother Mouzone.

the-wire.title: Time After Time
the-wire.synopsis: The demolition of the Franklin Terrace towers scatters the Barksdale crew, Stringer tries a new business approach, and McNulty's unit goes after Proposition Joe's operation.

the-wire.title: All Due Respect
the-wire.synopsis: Omar keeps raiding Barksdale stash houses, Bodie is ordered to confront ambitious young dealer Marlo Stanfield, and McNulty quietly reopens a closed case from the previous year.

the-wire.title: Dead Soldiers
the-wire.synopsis: Major Colvin gets grilled over crime statistics at a tense Comstat meeting, a compromised wiretap forces a change of target, and Carcetti cultivates influence at City Hall.

the-wire.title: Amsterdam
the-wire.synopsis: Colvin surprises a community meeting with blunt honesty, Bubbles finds an unlikely job, and Stringer pursues legitimate business while Greggs watches how Marlo operates.

the-wire.title: Straight and True
the-wire.synopsis: Frustrated by the drug war's futility, Colvin takes a radical idea directly to the corner bosses, while McNulty worries Stringer is slipping beyond the reach of police.

the-wire.title: Homecoming
the-wire.synopsis: Stringer learns the hard realities of real estate development, Bunk tracks down Omar with a pointed message, and Avon dispatches Cutty and Slim Charles against Marlo.

the-wire.title: Back Burners
the-wire.synopsis: Herc uncovers a connection from the past, Daniels learns why his detail was really reassigned, and Stringer gets worrying news about who might talk to McNulty.

the-wire.title: Moral Midgetry
the-wire.synopsis: Colvin's experiment in tolerated drug zones gains momentum, Prez mines a cell phone for clues that send McNulty and Greggs on a road trip, and a community leader raises concerns.

the-wire.title: Slapstick
the-wire.synopsis: McNulty and Prez answer an officer's call for help in a dark alley, and gunfire on a Sunday breaks a fragile peace among Baltimore's drug crews.

the-wire.title: Reformation
the-wire.synopsis: Brother Mouzone returns to Baltimore seeking payback and hunts for Omar, while Colvin dodges a curious reporter and Daniels pursues a new kind of wiretap.

the-wire.title: Middle Ground
the-wire.synopsis: The wiretap starts producing useful intelligence on the Barksdale organization, and Stringer and Avon look back on how far they have come together.

the-wire.title: Mission Accomplished

shogun.title: Anjin

shogun.title: A Dream of a Dream
